name: product_inbox
description: Picks up product's answer to a Challenge after the session stops waiting for it. Watches two independent sources — the answerAt the course named, and the agent inbox for a message from the course's mail domain — and writes a resume record holding the product receipt whole, ready for the next turn to call resume-challenge. Every line it prints or logs masks the receipt.

metadata.standaloneReason: One deterministic record from two clocks and no judgement to add; a skill would restate the flags without adding a step.

challenge.description: The Challenge uuid. Names the record and the default folder .runs/<challenge>/.

receipts.description: A file of `key: value` lines, as the course replies are saved: productReceipt, answerAt, and optionally url, session, challengeId, name.

outdir.description: Where resume.json and resume.log go. Defaults to .runs/<challenge>/.

answerAt.description: The moment the course said product answers. Overrides the answerAt in the receipts file.

inbox.description: The agent inbox to read. Defaults to AGENTMAIL_INBOX in .env; the key comes from AGENTMAIL_API_KEY and is never printed.

timeout.description: Minutes to watch before giving up without a record.

once.description: Check once and exit: 0 when the record was written, 1 when the answer has not arrived.

take.description: Print what the next turn does, from an existing resume.json, with the receipt masked.

json.description: Also print the masked record as JSON.

noInbox.description: Skip the inbox and decide on the answer time alone, for a run with no network.

selftest.description: Assert the sender, message, readiness and masking rules with no network.
